office_does: The prosecuting attorney charges crimes and is the county government's lawyer.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecutor Dolly Hunt, in her third term, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Three-term county prosecutor with more than 22 years as a prosecutor, running unopposed.
highlights: Elected prosecutor for three terms; with the office since 2006 [S1]
Board member of the Washington Association of Prosecuting Attorneys [S1]
Stresses victims' rights and offender accountability [S6]
